intent.raw: Refresh the learning-map plan after the DomainSpec minted-project runtime implementation completed.
intent.objective: Produce a proposal-only route correction that enables candidate implementation without collapsing it into FPR authority.
intent.operator_sentence: Use the DomainSpec graph to implement the learning map, prioritize code, and preserve the authority boundary.

boundaries.contract: Inventory returns non-authority handles; material status claims are verified against owner-held receipts.
The learning map may propose candidate use of tested runtime contracts but may not infer FPR authority, admission, release, or promotion.
Only owner-issued FPR receipts may authorize the authoritative posture; candidate output cannot satisfy G-DSV2-SG.
Refresh outputs are proposal-only; the existing plan remains unchanged until posture approval and apply-approved refresh.

authority.evidence: DomainSpec task receipts, implementation contracts, and Inventory handles
authority.promotion: DomainSpec FPR, CAV2, Definitions, and private product owners remain separate

state_namespaces.write_policy: write only under the dated refresh folder
no writes or status changes from this dispatch

promotion_splits.source: candidate minted-project graph and learning evidence
promotion_splits.target: authoritative FPR Sg, admitted runtime, ontology promotion, or production website
promotion_splits.rule: Candidate evidence may inform later decisions but cannot promote itself across any target boundary.

steps.name: Resolve current target, guard, FPR, and runtime evidence

capability_metadata.scope: repository-local Inventory lookup followed by owner-receipt verification

stop_conditions: block if implementation evidence is treated as authority evidence
block if live receipts contradict the Inventory handle

steps.name: Normalize refresh signals and author proposal-only deltas
stop_conditions: block if a proposed delta lacks a typed RefreshSignal
block if any existing target or upstream artifact changes
block if candidate and authoritative postures collapse

steps.name: Route the consequential posture choice

capability_metadata.scope: deferred blocker-level posture choice; no decision is executed by this refresh

stop_conditions: defer target mutation while posture is unresolved
block any option that lets candidate evidence waive FPR ownership

steps.name: Validate refresh artifacts and route boundaries
stop_conditions: block on dispatch schema or technique errors
flag rather than apply while posture approval is absent

gates.condition: Source evidence, target inventory, scope, evidence date, and proposal-only mode are explicit.
Only the dated refresh folder and observability envelope change; target and upstream artifacts remain unchanged.

gates.owner: DomainSpec FPR and private learning-map owners
gates.condition: Candidate behavior evidence cannot satisfy authoritative FPR, admission, ontology promotion, or production gates.

gates.owner: operator and private learning-product plan owner
gates.condition: Target mutation remains deferred until D-IOLM-POSTURE is explicitly selected.
Dispatch, JSON, paths, proposal-only scope, and diff checks return evidence.

promotion_guardrails: One graph contract may carry candidate or authoritative provenance, but the postures never imply each other.
Invoke owns only the refresh proposal, not target application, prototype execution, or FPR lifecycle state.
Minted-project conformance is implementation evidence and cannot grant release admission.
The learning map may consume a later FPR Sg read-only but cannot mint its authority receipts.
Proposal approval is not implementation, ontology promotion, publication, or production-host approval.
